derivation:
by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (AdicCompletion.evalOneₐ I x)
  exact ⟨a, by simp [← AdicCompletion.ker_evalOneₐ_eq_map I I.fg_of_isNoetherianRing, ha]⟩
explanation: Choose a representative of the image of x modulo I. The kernel identity then shows that x minus this representative belongs to the mapped ideal. Noetherianity supplies finite generation.
